name: Bempegaldesleukin
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "A re-engineered interleukin-2 meant to be a safer version of a famous old immunotherapy. It added nothing to nivolumab in three phase 3 trials."
fields.after: "Bempegaldesleukin was a re-engineered interleukin-2 meant to be a safer version of a famous old immunotherapy. It added nothing to nivolumab in three phase 3 trials."
